acquirerId.description: Unique identification of the acquirer, determined by equensWorldline

holdingId.description: Unique identification of the holding, determined by equensWorldline

status.description: The status of this entity. Values [Active]

holdingDetailsURI.description: URI to get the holding details

streetName.description: Street name and house number of the address. In case of a Dutch address only Street name

houseNumber.description: House number. Only used for Dutch addresses

houseAddition.description: House number addition. Only used for Dutch addresses

region.description: Region of the address. Only applicable for specific countries

countryCode.description: Country of the address according to ISO 3166-1 (numeric-3)

contactPersonName.description: Name of the contact person registered with the address

telephoneNumber.description: Telephone number of contact person registered with the address

email.description: E-mail address of the contact person registered with the address
